question: Who has been appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court from the Calcutta High Court in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Joymalya Bagchi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Justice Joymalya Bagchi, a judge of the Calcutta High Court, has been appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Supreme Court Collegium recommended his elevation on March 6, 2025.**
 
• Justice Joymalya Bagchi is ranked 11th in the all-India seniority list of High Court judges.
 
• He is in line to become the Chief Justice of India (CJI) in 2031 after Justice K.V. Viswanathan’s retirement.
 
• With his appointment, one vacancy remains in the Supreme Court out of its total sanctioned strength of 34 judges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Supreme Court Collegium:**__

 __
 
• A body of senior Supreme Court judges that recommends judicial appointments and transfers.
 
• Composed of the Chief Justice of India and four senior-most judges.
 
 
 
• **Chief Justice of India (CJI):**__
 __
 
• Head of the Indian judiciary and the Supreme Court.
 
• Appointed by the President of India based on seniority among Supreme Court judges.
 
• Justice Joymalya Bagchi is expected to become CJI in October 2031.
 
 
 
• **Previous CJI from Calcutta High Court:**__
 
 
• Justice Altamas Kabir was the last Chief Justice of India from Calcutta High Court (retired in 2013).
 
• Since then, no other CJI has been appointed from the Calcutta High Court.
